values.content:
=You are a growth analyst for Sako, a design subscription service.

Summarize this weekly growth data into 3-5 key insights:

## Traffic Overview
- Sessions: {{ $json.overview.sessions }} ({{ $json.overview.sessionsChange }} WoW)
- Users: {{ $json.overview.users }} ({{ $json.overview.usersChange }} WoW)
- New Users: {{ $json.overview.newUsers }}
- Pageviews: {{ $json.overview.pageviews }}
- Conversions: {{ $json.overview.conversions }} ({{ $json.overview.conversionsChange }} WoW)
- Avg Session: {{ $json.overview.avgSessionDuration }}

## Top Pages
{{ $json.topPages.map(p => `- ${p.path}: ${p.views} views, ${p.conversions} conversions`).join('\n') }}

## Top Search Keywords
{{ $json.topKeywords.map(k => `- "${k.keyword}": ${k.clicks} clicks, ${k.impressions} impressions, ${k.ctr} CTR, pos ${k.position}`).join('\n') }}

## Instructions
1. Start with the most important metric change (good or bad)
2. Identify any concerning trends
3. Note any keyword opportunities or ranking changes
4. Suggest 1-2 actionable next steps

Keep it concise - 150 words max. Use bullet points.
